subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 长春仙馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 茹古涵今之南為長春仙館門三楹正殿五楹後殿為緑䕃軒正殿西廊後為麗景軒（圓明園冊）臣等謹按長春仙館為皇上舊時賜居四十景之一也其後恭值佳辰令節迎奉安輿駐居斯館殿額與緑䕃軒麗景軒諸額皆御書殿内聨曰安輿歡洽宜春永慶節誠依愛日長亦御書
evidence.summary: South of 茹古涵今: 長春仙館, a three-bay gate and five-bay main hall, 緑䕃軒 behind and 麗景軒 to the west. The note says this was Qianlong's own residence as a prince, later used to receive his mother on festival days.

evidence.title: 藤影花丛: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.179 item (1), under 藤影花丛
evidence.excerpt_zh: 藤影当春拓，花丛待雨催。庭前多胜赏，砌右得清陪。印月枝微布，临风蕊渐开。即欣生气满，艳丽徧亭台。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 藤影花丛, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 藤影花丛: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.179 item (2), under 藤影花丛
evidence.excerpt_zh: 藤影临风牵旧碧，花丛映日拓新红。卷舒卉木原无意，旋转生成总化工。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 藤影花丛, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 藤影花丛: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.179 item (3), under 藤影花丛
evidence.excerpt_zh: 文轩仰题额，四字景该全。藤影到春密，花丛映日鲜。缘墙阴合匝，照座馥清妍。植物邀宸赏，滋培近百年。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 藤影花丛, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 藤影花丛
evidence.locator: from p.179, under 长春仙馆
evidence.summary: 藤影花丛: 3 dated items, 1797-1798, of which 3 poems (Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1797, last dated 1798.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
